svg.title: Latest from the shipping log
svg.desc: Latest from the shipping log. 23 Nov 2026, codehorizon.in: Page changes now sweep a curved stroke across the screen, in each product’s colour. 18 Nov 2026, Open source: Two more fixes merged into Wikimedia Commons: shared photos and failed previews. 17 Nov 2026, Promo films: Animated films for eight products, on YouTube, Google Play and codehorizon.in. 6 Nov 2026, Feathervid: Free video and audio tools that run in the browser, live at feathervid.com.
